thesis_points: Quality over speed: replacing Forever 21 vacancies (~570K sqft) with experiential anchors at >2x legacy rents

Portfolio moat: 42 Class A malls in prime coastal metros (CA, NY, AZ, NJ, PA), $894/SF go-forward tenant sales
16 consecutive quarters of positive leasing spreads; SNO pipeline $90–140M+; new leases 9% above renewals
Deleveraging roadmap: $6.6B → ~$4.5B debt by 2029–2030, targeting ~6x ND/EBITDA via asset sales

key_debate.street: High leverage (8.2x vs SPG 5.7x, SKT 5.4x), tenant bankruptcies (Forever 21, Claire's) signal structural decline
key_debate.our_view: Occupancy gap is deliberate — quality tenants commanding >2x prior rents. Deleveraging credibly underway with $395M B/C sales in 2025

overview.narrative:
REITs traded mixed Tuesday with a clear quality-and-duration bid as net lease (+1.27%) and retail (+1.21%) led while office (-1.26%) and hospitality (-0.70%) lagged. The session's risk-on tone in defensive rate-sensitive names suggests the market is pricing in a more dovish Fed path heading into next week's CPI print. CCI's +3.07% surge paced all names, likely reflecting renewed conviction in the tower secular growth story, while PLD (+2.43%) stood out in an otherwise modest industrial tape (+0.63%).

The intra-sector divergences are notable. Towers saw a massive 550bp spread between CCI (+3.07%) and UNIT (-2.45%), underscoring the market's preference for scaled infrastructure over fiber-heavy models. Office remains uninvestable broadly — ESRT (-2.99%) and SLG (-2.46%) dragged despite CUZ eking out +0.36% — suggesting any office recovery thesis remains highly name-specific. Healthcare's +0.99% average masked ARE's -0.92% decline, as life science office exposure continues to weigh against senior housing strength led by WELL (+2.11%).

Positioning into Wednesday should favor the momentum in net lease and retail defensives if rates cooperate. We'd be cautious chasing CCI after a 3% move but would look for PLD follow-through as a signal of broader industrial re-rating. Office shorts remain consensus and crowded — watch for any squeeze catalyst.
